clean_plates.purpose: Original approved covers were edited with the built-in imagegen tool to remove near foreground occluders and reconstruct plausible background. Architecture, camera, sky and lighting were kept fixed; only the hidden portion is consumed by the mechanically split runtime art.
clean_plates.scarlet: Remove near torii, hanging cherry branch and nearest wet floor. Reveal temple grounds, mist and rocks behind. Preserve central palace, staircase, lights, mountains and moon.
clean_plates.atlantis: Remove near left/right columns, shell, coral and nearest mosaic floor. Reveal underwater city and seabed behind. Preserve dome, middle architecture and surface lighting.
clean_plates.cathedral: Remove near left Gothic framing arch, stained-glass column and balcony. Reveal clouds and distant sky behind. Preserve main cathedral, rose window, bridges and distant spires.
